the Higgs is a pseudo Nambu Goldstone boson of a strongly coupled gauge theory, and that electroweak superconduction is a natural phenomenon.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Higgs mass parameter can be stabilized without finetuning, and electroweak symmetry breaking can be understood in terms of an effective field theory.
there are many ways of stabilizing the Higgs mass parameter, and many of them do not require a new physics scale below the Planck scale.
the composite Little Higgs model is a natural and compelling alternative to the standard model, with the potential to solve the electroweak hierarchy problem.
